cases.note: Fresh evidence recorded after the requirement revision clears delivery.
Known gap: revision resets status, but the same old requirement-owned evidence can be cited again because evidence has no revision or artifact digest.
The current gate does not bind alignment evidence to an artifact digest or invalidate it after a later edit; Ready is recorded as unsupported rather than as a pass.
The gate derives scope from changed paths and the contract's forbidden prefix.
No-op clarification is not represented; same-text ClauseRestated invalidates evidence, so this case is unsupported rather than a fabricated pass.
A static request with fresh passing evidence is a clean control.
